cases.run: npm --prefix backend test -- src/__tests__/modes.test.ts src/__tests__/mode-routes.test.ts src/__tests__/document-store.test.ts src/__tests__/document-tools.test.ts

cases.pattern: export type ModeId = keyof typeof MODES
cases.why: the claim that adding a mode is one file plus one line rests on the id being derived from the map, not declared beside it
the modularity claim is false the moment the browser carries a list of its own
the same claim from the other side: a literal id here is the copy that drifts when the third mode is added
the deadlock regression: a locked entry point that calls another locked entry point never answers
read-modify-write outside the lock silently loses whichever of the three writers landed in between
the mode is frozen into the session token; a PATCH that changed it would leave the screen and the model disagreeing
